book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso bu yi kwe le
Juu chi yuuŋ gɛ̀ fe, Mɛɛle Madaleŋ bɛ Mɛɛle wu bwe Jɛm, mo Salome gu mɛɛ mà gwee wuŋ ki bo gɛɛŋ bo yefɛ gvunɛ chi Jiso yu.
Gɛ̀ bee baaŋ lo ataana gɛh no nshwa muu ta yi juu chi fwe chi kimaa le, bo ja bo gɛɛne fɛ jɛŋ.
Bo doo bo gɛɛne noo bo mo bo jɛme lɛbolɛbo lɛ laa le biŋsɛ yɛɛŋ tɛdɛ chì ba chi baŋɛ jwe wu jɛŋ yu fɛ bo lee la?
Geenɛ bo doo bo noŋ ajii, bo yɛŋ a ba biŋsɛ wa tɛdɛ chiyu. Tɛdɛ chinɛ gɛ̀ bee lo kibwee ki tɛdɛ.
Bo doo bo lee bo gɛɛŋ a jɛŋ, bo yɛŋ chumu wumu le wù nyu wu shii kibo kinchiɛɛŋ le wu noŋ nju yì ndefe, yi baaŋ. Ye kuufɛ bo nɛ wuuu.

Chumu wuyu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Keefɛ jwe yûŋ bɛŋ gɛ. Ŋkee lo lɛ bɛŋ goone nyu Jiso wu Nasalɛ wù ba chi ta yi kintaaŋ le. Gɛ wu baaŋ fɛnɛ gɛ. Wu le wu bu wa yi kwe le. Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ fɛ ba chi giŋsɛ wu fo.
Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ sɛ̂ɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le, mo Bita lɛ wu le wu sa wa bɛŋ fwe Galalee. Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ wu le yo no wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ wa bɛŋ le.”
Bikɛse baa bu a jɛŋ bo shiŋshi nɛ kikikiki, bo ja bo fɛɛ lo nje jwe gɛ̀ yuŋ bo nɛ kah. Bo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ fiɛɛ muh le gɛ, nje bo gɛ faane lo.
Jiso dunyɛ ye ye bamii le (Macho 28:9-10; Joŋ 20:11-18) [
Jiso gɛ̀ bu yi kwe le juu chi fwe chi kimaa le baaŋ kibilebile le, wu ya wu bunɛ nyu fɛ Mɛɛle Madaleŋ wù wu gɛ̀ bvusɛ banchɛndaa ba debele ye ye le bvusooshwi.
Mɛɛle mo wu gɛɛŋ wu sɛɛŋ bamii ba bɛ ba Jiso gɛ̀ kɛ bo nyume le. Bamii banɛ gɛ̀ shii bo beede bo soge bikwɛɛ.
Bo doo bo yu no kwɛse wɛɛ duu lɛ wu be wu yɛŋ Jiso le, lɛ wu le yu, bo gɛ bɛɛŋ gɛ mbɛŋ.
Ajiŋ ayu Jiso ka wu dunyɛ ye ye bamii be bamu ba ŋgoo le bafɛɛ bo gɛɛne ntɛ wumu le, nfiɛɛnɛ ye nyu yi kusɛ wa.
Bo tu jiŋ, bo gɛɛŋ bo sɛɛŋ kimbɛge ki bamii ba ŋgoo le, bo faŋ ki bo bɛɛŋ bo le.

Ajiŋ ayu Jiso dunyɛ ye ye nyu wa booŋ be ba yuufe ncho wu mumwaa le kibɛɛ bɛ bo jii mwɛɛ. Wu sa bo, nje bo gɛ̀ kɛme gɛ mbɛmɛ gɛ, bo tɛɛme bikwɛɛ ki bo bɛɛŋ bamii ba gɛ̀ yɛŋ wu le sege wù gɛ̀ bu yi kwe le.
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ woŋ le wuchii, bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ fêeji saaka wù joŋe wù le wu Nyo bamii le bachii.
Muh wù bɛɛŋ saaka wuyu le, ba leesɛ wu a joo, lé wu gê wu bônɛ. Muh wù baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ, lé wu gê wu gwê nsa.
Bamii ba bɛɛŋ lé bo gê bo gêe mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo njɛ munɛ: Bo lé bo gê bo bvûuse banchɛndaa ba debele yi bamii le, a jee chaŋ le. Bo lé bo gê bo jɛ̂me jɛ́ yì fiɛŋ.
Bo lé bo jîji yó le bɛ chiaaŋ. Nɛ bo mu nlo, wu gɛ ge fiɛɛ bɛ bo gɛ. Bo lé bo gɛ̂ɛde chiaaŋ yi bamii ba chɛne le, bo tɛɛme.”

content: Jiso bɛɛŋ we
Tada Jiso jɛmɛ bo le noo wu mɛsɛ, Nyo mo wu jo wu, wu bɛɛŋ we wu shii a kibo ki Nyo kinchiɛɛŋ le.
Booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo bu bo tu bo jiɛnyi bo feeji saaka wù joŋe manjuu le manchii. Tada lɛne bɛ bo wu toone fiɛɛ fì bo gɛ̀ feeji lɛ le nchiɛɛŋ bɛ mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo, mù bo gɛ̀ gee.]

footnotes.text: Gɛ baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme binchiŋ bi 16:9-20 gɛ.
